verdict.rationale: Trello's own marketing claims built-in automation ('Automate tasks and workflows with Trello'), but nothing in the pack documents defining event-based rules (trigger conditions mapped to actions). Webhooks and Power-Up buttons are developer building blocks or manual triggers, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of a rule builder with event triggers and actions, examples of supported events/actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automate tasks and workflows with Trello.
